name: Breadboard Builder
description: Place schematic components on a virtual breadboard and validate wiring against the KiCad netlist.
description_full:
A KiCad Action Plugin for introductory analog electronics courses.

Draw your schematic in Eeschema, then wire up the same circuit on a virtual breadboard — placing components, drawing jumper wires, and validating your work against the schematic netlist in real time.

Features:
- Six configurable breadboard sizes (mini to triple)
- Component tray: drag resistors, capacitors, diodes, LEDs, BJTs, JFETs, MOSFETs, op-amps, DIP ICs, Arduino, Raspberry Pi Pico, and more onto the board
- Real-time validation against the KiCad netlist (open nets and shorts highlighted)
- Bendable jumper wires with selectable or auto-cycled colours
- Drawing annotations: lines, rectangles, circles, text, and text boxes
- SPICE simulation from the breadboard view (DC operating point and KiScope transient)
- Instrument probes: function generator, oscilloscope channels, PSU connections
- Net highlighting from board holes or the net list overlay
- Export to PNG or SVG
- Save / load board sessions (.kicad_bbrd)
- Configurable rails, binding-post placement, and baseboard branding
